name: Floating Flowers
source:
Well, you finally got a job!

Sure, it's on a strange forest moon on the other side of the galaxy, but you hear the scientists there are cute.

An adult dating game featuring hand-drawn art by me, world famous webcomic artist* Forview! This is an extremely early version, but I did make sure there was some porn in it.

*I once got an email from Australia.

You can play as a man or woman. All other characters are women.

This game doesn't really feature any significant fetishes and doesn't break any typical laws about content. I'll be polishing both the game as time goes on.

It may feel a bit rushed right now, since this isn't a "chapter by chapter" release. To make sure there was some adult content, I wedged some midgame content into the early game. It'll sort itself out as things develop.

Edited from https://forview.itch.io/
translation:
嗯，你终于找到工作了！

当然，它位于银河系另一边的一个奇怪的森林卫星上，但你听说那里的科学家很可爱。

一款由世界著名网络漫画艺术家我手绘的成人约会游戏* 敬请期待！这是一个非常早期的版本，但我确实确保其中有一些色情内容。

*我曾经收到一封来自澳大利亚的电子邮件。

你可以扮演男人或女人。所有其他角色都是女性。

这款游戏并没有真正具有任何明显的迷恋特征，也没有违反任何有关内容的典型法律。随着时间的推移，我将完善这两款游戏。

现在可能感觉有点仓促，因为这不是“逐章”发布。为了确保有一些成人内容，我在早期游戏中加入了一些游戏中期内容。随着事情的发展它会自行解决。
